arrival.speaker: Grandma Wang
arrival.say: Welcome to Scholar Village! Everyone has been mixing up their words since the Muddle King arrived.

arrival.speaker: Grandma Wang
arrival.say: Long ago, Word Spirits helped people speak, read and write clearly. The Great Forgetter scattered them across the land.

arrival.speaker: Grandma Wang
arrival.say: Come upstairs. Something in the attic has been waiting for you.

attic.speaker: Grandma Wang
attic.say: This is the handle of the Spirit Brush. It glows when someone truly knows a word.

attic.speaker: Fogling
attic.say: A Fogling bursts from an old scroll. The word spirit 露营 is trapped inside!

reform.speaker: Muddle King
reform.say: I surrender! The Great Forgetter told me that mistakes should make people give up.

reform.speaker: Grandma Wang
reform.say: Mistakes help us learn when we look at them carefully.

reform.speaker: Muddle King
reform.say: Then I shall open a Mistake Museum and display the funniest muddles we have fixed!

reform.speaker: Spirit Brush
reform.say: Dawn Stroke restored. Thick fog can now be cleared.

stories.title: The Missing Treasure
pages: The class camps in the forest and learns never to explore alone.
Xiaoqiang falls during a team race, but everyone works together and finishes.
His missing ‘valuable treasure’ turns out to be one of his mother’s pork ribs.

stories.title: Dad Cannot See
pages: Mr Lin stares at his computer until his eyes become tired and blurry.
The whole family searches for his glasses everywhere.
A doctor points out that the glasses have been sitting on his head all along.

stories.title: The Most Special Birthday Gift
pages: The family prepares a birthday meal and card for Grandma.
Sugar is added instead of salt, and everyone falls silent.
Grandma says that working together is the best gift, and the family celebrates.
